outcome_label_en: Residents aged 65+ certified at long-term care grade 1 or 2 under Korea's long-term care insurance (NHIS long-term care statistics DT_35006_N009, annual)
disease_en: Severe care dependency (long-term care grade 1-2 certification) in later life
pathway: care-dependency epidemiology set: certification = need x application and assessment pathway. Care supply and access (long-term care hospitals, hospitals); application and recognition pathway (tertiary education, older people living alone, stroke and dementia burden); deprivation (public assistance, medical aid type 1); survival (all-cause mortality); walking as one factor among several
pool_note: Number of long-term care institutions is not in the reference dataset; long-term care benefit users are excluded (circular with the outcome); outside-district care share is sensitivity-only; public health centre use is sensitivity-only (2023-2024 break)
selection_basis: Outcome selected by spatial screening criteria fixed before results (adjusted Moran's I >= 0.25, permutation p < 0.001, urban-rural R2 < 0.40, BYM2 mixing >= 0.5, persistence >= 0.5)
graph: Principal adjacency graph in INLA graph format, read from the ST_GRAPH environment variable (229 districts, 593 edges, boundary-file order)

population_override.source: KOSIS DT_1YL20651E, 2023 total for the integrated Changwon city

version: std3 care-dependency epidemiology set (care supply and access, application and recognition pathway, deprivation, survival; walking as one factor among several), 2011-2024
fixed_on: hashed (SHA-256) and recorded in the analysis log before the covariate models were fitted

expected_direction.ext__ltc_hospitals_per100k_65: - (long-term care hospitals per 100 000 aged 65+: substitution outside long-term care insurance; alternative + = supply-induced referral; two-sided interpretation fixed)
expected_direction.ext__hospitals_per100k: + (hospitals and general hospitals per 100 000: diagnosis and referral access; alternative - = acute inpatient substitution)
expected_direction.ext__tertiary_educated_share: + (tertiary-educated share: information and application capacity; alternative - = better health; census interpolated, 2021-24 carried forward)
expected_direction.ext__living_alone_elderly: + (older single-person households: absence of family care leads to formal applications; 2011-14 carried back)
expected_direction.ext__mort_stroke_asr: + (cerebrovascular age-standardised mortality: stroke burden, severe dependency)
expected_direction.ext__alz_death_sir_ma3: + (Alzheimer disease death SIR, 3-year moving average: dementia burden)
expected_direction.ext__basic_livelihood_rate: + (public assistance recipient rate: deprivation, multimorbidity; alternative - = pro-rich gradient of formal care use; two-sided)
expected_direction.ext__medical_aid1_per100k: + (medical aid type 1 patients per 100 000: deprivation; alternative - = application barriers; two-sided)
expected_direction.ext__mort_allcause_asr: - (all-cause age-standardised mortality: survival is needed to reach severe dependency)
expected_direction.ext__walking_rate: - (walking practice: functional maintenance, one factor among several)

evidence.ext__ltc_hospitals_per100k_65: literature keys: kim2015delivery; kim2020variations; sakong2017panel; seo2021effect

rules.likelihood: Poisson or negative binomial, whichever forced-adjustment-only model has the lower WAIC
rules.set_choice: Lowest WAIC; within 4 WAIC points, the set with fewer variables
rules.main_model_note: Principal model = S1_narrative_full (10 hypothesised characteristics + 5 fixed adjustments); the set is not changed after fitting; candidates with VIF > 10 are removed by 80 (vif_action drop); the chain stops if a fixed adjustment keeps VIF > 10.
rules.windows_note: Three periods fixed before results were seen.

note: LTCS = residents aged 65+ certified at long-term care insurance grade 1 (95 points or more) or grade 2 (75 to under 95 points); the grade 1-2 thresholds are unchanged 2008-2025. Grade 5 (2014) and the cognitive-support grade (2018) were added below 75 points (national grade 1-2 ratio 2013 to 2014: 1.009).
sens_note: sensitivity: age-only standardised expected counts (5 bands, 65+)
